fact: The ETA said 2025 returns are received from 1 January 2026 electronically through its official platforms, with taxpayers of the large, medium and integrated tax centres filing on the new core tax system and all others on the e-services portal.
title: تيسيرات موسعة ودعم فني شامل لتسهيل تقديم الإقرارات الضريبية
